title: Onboarding cockpit
introManage: UTA new customers from the Salesforce report: prio cases first, follow-ups in view, every contact logged per customer. Assign cases to the team here.
introOwn: Your onboarding cases: contact prio cases first, keep your follow-ups, log every contact.
adminsOnlyHint: The team only sees the cockpit once ONBOARDING_MODE=live is set.

kpi.filterHint: Click a figure to filter the list.

assignDone: {count, plural, one {# case assigned} other {# cases assigned}}
archived: {count, plural, one {# case archived} other {# cases archived}}
unarchived: {count, plural, one {# case restored} other {# cases restored}}

empty.noCasesOwn: No case has been assigned to you yet.
empty.prio: No open prio cases. They come from the prio list on import or by hand in a case.
empty.followUps: No follow-ups planned. Set a date when you log a contact.

prioIntro: Open prio cases – overdue follow-ups and oldest cases first.
followUpIntro: Only the onboarding cockpit's follow-ups – separate from the intranet calendar.
archiveIntro: Archived cases count nowhere. A new import doesn't change them.

case.notePlaceholder: What was discussed, what is open?
case.noteHint: Stays on the case and shows in the list. Saved when you leave the field.

import.reportHint: Salesforce export (e.g. “KI_Onboarding_all”) as .xlsx or .csv. New customers are created, known ones updated. Status, assignment, prio and follow-ups stay as they are.
import.prioHint: File with customer numbers to contact first. Matches get the prio mark.
import.readError: The file couldn't be read. Please save it as .xlsx or .csv.
import.mappingHint: Detected automatically – please check. All other columns are kept on the case.
import.skipped: {skipped} rows without a customer number, {duplicates} duplicates – skipped.
import.reportDone: {created} new, {updated} updated, {missing} no longer in report.
import.noNumberColumn: Please choose the customer number column.

create.title: Add a customer by hand
create.intro: For customers not (yet) in the report. A later report with the same customer number fills in the report columns.
create.error: Couldn't add – does the customer number exist already?

export.done: {count, plural, one {# case exported} other {# cases exported}}

calendar.overdue: {count, plural, one {# follow-up overdue} other {# follow-ups overdue}}
calendar.overdueHint: Click to reschedule or drag into the calendar.
calendar.hint: Click a follow-up to open the customer file. Drag it to another day or time to move it. Click a day to open the day view.

viewAs.label: View as
viewAs.banner: You're seeing the cockpit as {name}: only their cases, employee view. Changes in a customer file are saved with your own rights.

dist.noTeam: No team set yet – pick the members under “Team” below, otherwise nothing can be distributed.
dist.distributeHint: The proposal levels out new cases: whoever has fewer gets more. Example: 100 cases, A has 100 new, B 50 → A gets 25, B 75. Numbers can be changed before applying. Prio and oldest cases go out first, in turns.
dist.onlyNew: New cases only (no step done yet)
dist.reassignHint: For holidays or sickness: split one person's cases among others or put them back into the pool. Prio and oldest first.
dist.toHint: Several people: cases are split in turns.
dist.teamHint: Who works onboarding (gets cases when distributing), who is paused (holiday, sick – gets no new ones) and who leads the team (may distribute like an admin; set by admins only).
